- NumPy
- Pandas

## Learning Topics

### 1. Neural Network Fundamentals

- Biological Neuron vs Artificial Neuron
- Perceptron
- Activation Functions
- Forward Propagation
- Loss Functions
- Backpropagation
- Gradient Descent
- Optimizers

### 2. Artificial Neural Network (ANN)

- ANN Architecture
- Input, Hidden and Output Layers
- Weight and Bias
- Model Compilation
- Model Training
- Model Evaluation
- Overfitting and Underfitting
- Regularization
- Dropout
- Early Stopping

### 3. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)

- Convolution Operation
- Filters and Feature Maps
- Padding and Stride
- Pooling Layers
- Flattening
- CNN Architecture
- Image Classification
- Transfer Learning

### 4. Recurrent Neural Network (RNN)

- Sequential Data
- Recurrent Neural Network
- Vanishing Gradient Problem
- Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM)
- Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU)
- Time Series Prediction
- Sequence Modeling

### 5. Transformer

- Attention Mechanism
- Self-Attention
- Multi-Head Attention
- Positional Encoding
- Encoder and Decoder
- Transformer Architecture
- Introduction to Large Language Models (LLMs)

## Goal

To build a strong foundation in Deep Learning, understand modern neural network architectures, implement research-based models, and become a skilled AI/ML Engineer.

More implementations, experiments, and projects will be added as I continue learning.
